text:
A thousand years before You are like a dream.

Like the thickness of an avenue of waters.

Grass that grows in the morning,

blooms and grows in the morning

though by evening it is cut and dries.


What is time before You, what are the thunders

you brandish against me when you name me?

I feel terror at your idea, I see you grim

looking at me in the flame of your Archangel.

You are the sword too, the edge

and the pommel gripped by the fist.


To see Yourself you have born me.

So as not to be alone with your omnipotence.

I am nothingness, I am of time, I am a dream...

Water that flows to you, acid grass

that you cut without love...

You do not love me.

translation.title: A Thousand Years Before You Are Like a Dream...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the psalm-like time image and the stark accusation that God does not love the speaker.
